title: Daily strategy and automatic paper trading
checked: Automatic strategy checked; runtime status updated
cadenceSummary: Daily strategy; up to {{orders}} ordinary orders per rolling 7 days. Protective exits bypass frequency limits.
cadenceHint: Daily research and execution use the market calendar. Cooldowns still approximate trading days with weekdays; weekly limits use a rolling 7-day window. Protective exits bypass these frequency limits.
riskHint: Protective exits can run after daily loss or order-count limits are reached. Quote, session, sellable-position and T+1 checks still apply.
emptyInbox: Automatic plans and execution status appear above; view fills in the paper account. This inbox keeps pending proposals from rule scan mode.
intro: Your research team prepares a daily plan. The monitor checks its conditions during market hours, then requests a fast review before paper execution.
enableHint: Research runs on each market's trading day. Save and activate to begin.
needsCouncil: Enable the research team above to prepare daily strategies.
preOpenMinutes: Minutes before open to begin research
reviewerHint: Reviews candidates against actual quotes and calculated indicators. Preset protective stops use deterministic rules.
notificationHint: Uses your enabled notification channels. Add a channel in notification settings if needed.
runtimeHint: Monitoring requires a running server. Sleep or shutdown stops local monitoring. Quotes may be delayed; actual data times remain visible.
unavailable: Could not load runtime status. Refresh to try again.
empty: No daily plan yet. Once activated, research starts at the scheduled time.
noRules: The team recommends waiting. There are no executable conditions.
preview: Daily research → Market monitoring → Fast review → Risk checks → Paper fill → Notification
previewHint: Expired plans, unavailable quotes and declined reviews wait for another valid opportunity. No broker connection is used.
